title: Gemma 3 builds a linearly decodable spatial map from text, but its answers never read it [R]
summary: Independent, preregistered study on Gemma 3 (12B/27B) with text-only layouts like "A is 3 north of B, C is 2 east of A". - Probes read every object's position, even ones that need two sentences combined (R² 0.74). - Erasing that map costs no more than erasing random directions. T
